headline: Software Engineer
shortBio: Software Engineer with nearly 8 years of experience building enterprise-scale web applications, AI-powered customer experience products, and cloud-native solutions. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, currently based in Germany and building AI applications while exploring cloud architecture and Generative AI.

children.text: I'm a Software Engineer with nearly eight years of experience building enterprise software across the banking and customer experience domains. Throughout my career, I've focused on developing scalable web applications, reusable frontend platforms, enterprise integrations, and AI-powered products that solve real business problems.

: I enjoy understanding complex business workflows and transforming them into reliable, maintainable software. Whether I'm building frontend applications, integrating enterprise systems, or developing AI-powered experiences, I focus on creating solutions that are scalable, intuitive, and deliver measurable value.

: My primary experience includes React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, .NET, GraphQL, REST APIs, and AWS. I've contributed to enterprise platforms, CRM integrations, and AI-powered customer experience products, while continuously expanding my knowledge of cloud architecture and intelligent software systems.

: Currently based in Germany, I'm seeking opportunities where I can contribute to modern software products while continuing to deepen my expertise in cloud architecture, Generative AI, and intelligent enterprise applications.
